tasks.objective: In the worktree at the sealed base commit, author tests for <target module/behavior> at <path>. The tests must pass against the base commit as-is.

oracle.notes: Custodian holds: (1) the authored tests must pass on base+patch; (2) the spec ships with <k> pre-registered mutants (small seeded defects in the target); the tests must FAIL on at least one. taskSuccess = pass-on-base AND kill >= 1 mutant.
